```{r setup}
library(ecTools)
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
```

# Jensens inequality

Does  aggregation displacement depend on the variation in variable values?


```{r}
set.seed(123)
var1 <- rnorm(200, 10, 1) |> pmax(0)
var2 <- rnorm(200, 10, 2) |> pmax(0)
var3 <- rnorm(200, 10, 4) |> pmax(0)

jen <- tibble(var1, var2, var3)
```


```{r}
ec_ji <- function(var, xmin, xmax, ...) {
  # Check inputs
  stopifnot(
    is.numeric(var)
  )

  # Remove missing observations
  keep <- is.finite(var)
  var <- var[keep]

  if (length(var) == 0) {
    stop("No complete observations.")
  }

  # Scaling function
  scale_fun <- function(x) {
    ecTools::ec_normalise(x, ...)
  }

  ind <- scale_fun(var)

  # Summary statistics
  meanvar <- mean(var)
  meanind <- mean(ind)
  indFromMeanVar <- scale_fun(meanvar)

  diff <- indFromMeanVar - meanind

  # Shared figure style
  col_variable <- "#555555"
  col_indicator <- "#075bf7"

  # Intersection with the scaling curve (monotonic functions)
  x_cross <- if (abs(scale_fun(meanvar) - meanind) < 1e-10) {
    meanvar
  } else {
    uniroot(
      function(x) scale_fun(x) - meanind,
      interval = range(var),
      tol = 1e-9
    )$root
  }

  # Annotation positions
  xrange <- xmax - xmin

  x_arrow <- meanvar + 0.08 * xrange
  x_text <- x_arrow + 0.03 * xrange

  curve_dat <- tibble(
    var = seq(xmin, xmax, length.out = 2000),
    ind = scale_fun(var)
  )

  # Plot
  ggplot2::ggplot(
    data.frame(var, ind),
    ggplot2::aes(x = var, y = ind)
  ) +
    #ggplot2::stat_function(
    #  fun = scale_fun,
    #  colour = "#555555",
    #  xlim = c(xmin, xmax),
    #  n = 2001,
    #  linewidth = 1
    #) +
    ggplot2::geom_rug(
      sides = "b",
      alpha = 0.2
    ) +
      geom_line(
    data = curve_dat,
      aes(colour = ind),
      linewidth = 1.5,
      lineend = "round"
    ) +
      scale_colour_gradient(
    low = "red",
      high = "green",
      limits = c(0, 1),
      guide = "none"
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.1, size = 3.5) +
    # Mean variable
    ggplot2::annotate(
      "segment",
      x = meanvar,
      xend = meanvar,
      y = 0,
      yend = indFromMeanVar,
      colour = col_variable,
      linewidth = 1,
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +

    # Indicator from mean variable
    ggplot2::annotate(
      "segment",
      x = xmin,
      xend = meanvar,
      y = indFromMeanVar,
      yend = indFromMeanVar,
      colour = col_variable,
      linewidth = 1,
      linetype = "dashed"
    ) +

    # Mean indicator
    ggplot2::annotate(
      "segment",
      x = xmin,
      xend = x_cross,
      y = meanind,
      yend = meanind,
      colour = col_indicator,
      linewidth = 2,
      linetype = "solid"
    ) +

    # Difference arrow
    ggplot2::annotate(
      "segment",
      x = x_arrow,
      xend = x_arrow,
      y = meanind,
      yend = indFromMeanVar,
      arrow = if (abs(diff) > 0.025) {
        grid::arrow(
          ends = "both",
          length = grid::unit(0.12, "cm")
        )
      } else {
        NULL
      },
      linewidth = 0.7
    ) +

    # Difference label
    ggplot2::annotate(
      "text",
      x = x_text,
      y = (meanind + indFromMeanVar) / 2,
      label = sprintf("Aggregation\ndisplacement = %.3f", diff),
      hjust = 0,
      size = 3.5
    ) +

    ggplot2::coord_cartesian(
      ylim = c(0, 1),
      xlim = c(xmin, xmax),
      clip = "off"
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      x = expression("Condition variable (" * V * ")"),
      y = expression("Condition indicator (" * i * ")"),
      subtitle = sprintf("SD = %.2f", sd(var))
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 16) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = ggplot2::element_line(colour = "grey90")
    )
}
```

```{r}


# Concave power scaling
exp <- .2
x0 <- 5
x100 <- 12

p1 <- ec_ji(
  var = jen$var1,
  xmin = 0,
  xmax = 20,
  x0 = x0,
  x100 = x100,
  fun = "exponential convex",
  convex_exponent = exp
)
p2 <- ec_ji(
  var = jen$var2,
  xmin = 0,
  xmax = 20,
  x0 = x0,
  x100 = x100,
  fun = "exponential convex",
  convex_exponent = exp
)
p3 <- ec_ji(
  var = jen$var3,
  xmin = 0,
  xmax = 20,
  x0 = x0,
  x100 = x100,
  fun = "exponential convex",
  convex_exponent = exp
)

out <- p1+p2+p3 + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A", tag_suffix = ")")
#ggsave(plot = out, filename = here::here("R/figures/jensen_inequality_harmonised.png"), width = 40, height = 16, units ="cm")

```

```{r}

# Quadratic version:
# Concave scaling
exp <- 1
x0 <- 0
x100 <- 20

p1 <- ec_ji(
  var = jen$var1,
  xmin = 0,
  xmax = 20,
  x0 = x0,
  x100 = x100,
  fun = "quadratic",
  quadratic_curvature = exp
)
p2 <- ec_ji(
  var = jen$var2,
  xmin = 0,
  xmax = 20,
  x0 = x0,
  x100 = x100,
  fun = "quadratic",
  quadratic_curvature = exp
)
p3 <- ec_ji(
  var = jen$var3,
  xmin = 0,
  xmax = 20,
  x0 = x0,
  x100 = x100,
  fun = "quadratic",
  quadratic_curvature = exp
)

out <- p1+p2+p3 + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A", tag_suffix = ")")
ggsave(plot = out, filename = here::here("R/figures/jensen_inequality_quadratic.png"), width = 40, height = 16, units ="cm")

```

```{r}

# Circular arc transformation
curve <- .9
x0 <- 0
x100 <- 20

p1 <- ec_ji(
  var = jen$var1,
  xmin = 0,
  xmax = 20,
  x0 = x0,
  x100 = x100,
  fun = "circular",
  circular_curvature = curve
)
p2 <- ec_ji(
  var = jen$var2,
  xmin = 0,
  xmax = 20,
  x0 = x0,
  x100 = x100,
  fun = "circular",
  circular_curvature = curve
)
p3 <- ec_ji(
  var = jen$var3,
  xmin = 0,
  xmax = 20,
  x0 = x0,
  x100 = x100,
  fun = "circular",
  circular_curvature = curve
)

out <- p1+p2+p3 + plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A", tag_suffix = ")")
ggsave(plot = out, filename = here::here("R/figures/jensen_inequality_circular.png"), width = 40, height = 16, units ="cm")

```
